about.introduction: Hi! I'm Claudio Martín, a web developer based in Barcelona with more than 20 years of experience leading teams in the hospitality industry. In 2024, I completed a web development bootcamp at ITAcademy, consolidating my transition into the tech sector. I specialize in backend development with Node.js and databases such as MongoDB, MySQL and PostgreSQL. I also have experience in frontend technologies including HTML, CSS, React and Angular, along with UI design fundamentals. I currently work as a Support Engineer specialized in Microsoft Office 365 Security & Compliance.
